title: Waive on the largest live root exceeds the 1 s warm budget: attribute with a test-only count matrix, then fix format-preserving
outcome: Waive on the largest live root exceeds the 1 s warm budget: attribute with a test-only count matrix, then fix format-preserving
acceptance: A test-only per-operation count matrix for note, gate, decompose and waive at declared member compositions, using the existing root_state::Cost counters plus a member-row-read counter if needed, shows which structural work grows with members.

A format-preserving fix brings waive's warm MCP p95 within the fixed 1000 ms on a NEW declared synthetic benchmark, not a reproduction of the lost 2026-10-03 protocol: a retained manifest and harness at 6733 members and about 929647 bytes with its six member kinds declared; an unmodified baseline build and the candidate build run on the identical seed and protocol in a quiet slot; 20 warm full JSON-RPC round-trip samples per build with no retries or outlier removal and all errors kept; nearest-rank p95 reported with median and max; the historical 1032.6427 ms kept as a separate result.
Checksum semantics and the stored format remain unchanged; changing either requires a separately recorded store-format decision and migration.
